text:
marc: bringing up HF model 'open-chat-mini' on staging, converter failed during safetensors shard validation + token mapping. full error below.

marc: ERROR: MissingShardError: index.json references pytorch_model-00002-of-00003.safetensors but file not found in snapshot

anya: did snapshot_download include revision? we've seen hf_hub downloads return partial sets if revision omitted.

marc: i used our convert tool (redwood-hf-convert 0.9.1) which calls hf_hub_download per-file. It doesn't pass revision param in some codepath. quick log:

```
HF_HUB: attempting download: pytorch_model-00002-of-00003.safetensors
hf_hub_download(..., repo_id='org/open-chat-mini', filename='pytorch_model-00002-of-00003.safetensors')
# returns 404
```

sofia: also saw the tokenizer special tokens mapping get lost — converter rewrote `<|system|>` to `<sys>` in token_map and chat template then prompts shifted (eos/bos mismatch). can you paste config.json head?

marc: config head: {"architectures":["GPTForCausalLM"], "vocab_size":50257, "bos_token_id":50256, "eos_token_id":50256}

anya: eos==bos explains overlapping outputs. But the tokenizer change is separate — converter has a heuristic: rename 'special_tokens_map' keys to shorter ones. that's risky.

rahul: PR queued: we will 1) pin revision when calling hf_hub_download/snapshot_download, 2) validate index.json+all shards atomically, 3) stop automatic renaming of special token keys unless user opts in. branch: fix/hf-download-revision-pin

ci-bot: created PR #428 on fix/hf-download-revision-pin, tests failing on quantize path (key mismatch)

sofia: quant test failure: weight key rename problem: converter changed 'transformer.wte.weight' -> 'embed.weight' which breaks checkpoint-to-runtime mapping. simple map table needed.

marc: temporary workaround: `python convert.py --skip-token-rename --revision v1.2.3 --check-shards` worked for me.

anya: can someone add a small e2e that pulls a multi-shard safetensors model + ensures token map preserved? otherwise we'll keep regressing.

rahul: yep adding e2e + testcases and a followup to update docs on required revision use.

marc: thanks — will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
